description: This Java source file defines the OAuthConfig interface, which provides configuration settings related to OAuth, including protocol and openid connect issuers. It contains an inner enum for configuration values.

classes.name: OAuthConfig
classes.description: An interface providing OAuth-related configuration settings, including methods to retrieve protocol and issuer mappings, annotated as immutable and nonnull by default.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used to access OAuth endpoints.

methods.name: getOpenIdConnectIssuers
methods.description: Returns a map of supported OpenID Connect issuers.

methods.name: getOpenIdConnectIssuersExtension
methods.description: Returns a map of additional supported OpenID Connect issuers for migration or extended purposes.

inner_enum.name: OAuthConfigValue
inner_enum.description: Enumeration of configuration keys for OAuth settings, implementing KnownConfigValue with default values and config paths.

constants.name: PROTOCOL
constants.description: Represents the OAuth protocol setting with default 'https'.

constants.name: OPENID_CONNECT_ISSUERS
constants.description: Represents the setting for supported OpenID Connect issuers with default empty map.

constants.name: OPENID_CONNECT_ISSUERS_EXTENSION
constants.description: Represents the setting for additional OpenID Connect issuers with default empty map.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol to access OAuth endpoints.

methods.name: getOpenIdConnectIssuers
methods.description: Returns a map of supported OpenID connect issuers.

methods.name: getOpenIdConnectIssuersExtension
methods.description: Returns a map of additional OpenID connect issuers, used during migration phases.
